description:
Louisa is about an ex girlfriend back during my uni days. She was the last girl I was with before I went on tour and met my baby mother. Lived with her and we had jobs at different cinemas. We had different friends mostly of the opposite sex. Basically two walking red flags dating each other lol. 

This Little Town is a song written by my Dad back in the early 90's. It paints a simple idyllic image of our hometown. I'd say it 70 percent rings true. Its austere here, but the people get along for the most part. 

Don't Go To Cairns is a song about a current situationship where I did not commit for a long time, and she's decided to go to Australia as I wasn't committed. We got closer before she left and so its bittersweet. I don't know if she's heard this song, but I wanted to say these words. However, I didn't want to stop her living her life.
